The Provider and User pickers select the transactions recorded under those providers and / or users.
Provider on this report is the transaction provider (printed as Tran Prdr / Transaction Provider).
Transaction Date = the date the transaction was entered; Service Date = the date the service was completed. The vendor texts disagree on what Transaction Date is - see unresolved.
PATIENT NAME RANGE is an alphabetical range; entering the same patient as start and end limits the report to that one patient.
EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE works on the user-defined patient types (not on the ortho-patient flag behind PATIENT TYPE on the Daily Journal).
Selecting codes adds those payment / adjustment codes to the report; None (the default - there is a NONE button) leaves payments and adjustments out.
INSURANCE PLANS/SUB TYPES filters by specific insurance plans or by sub types (medical / dental).
The box selects procedure codes or ADA categories (default ALL); None (there is a NONE button) leaves procedures out of the report.
Age Range (From / To) is a filter on the age of the patient.
Group By (Code / Username / Insurance Plan / Transaction Provider) sets the group header and the order of the groups.
PRINT FORMAT = Excel downloads a file; the vendor article calls it a CSV in Excel format.
Office Group reproduces the older group-level report (Group Reports > Daily Reports > Special Transaction Report).
